assay_or_perturbation: SEMA7A ligation; integrin blockade; MAPK inhibition; axon-outgrowth assays
evidence_summary: SEMA7A-enhanced axon outgrowth required integrin receptors and MAPK signaling.
limitations: The source does not establish a terminal TF target and is not an SCI receiver-cell model.

assay_or_perturbation: OPN stimulation; αVβ3/integrin, FAK, PI3K/AKT, ERK and NF-κB inhibitors; migration assays
evidence_summary: OPN increased migration through αVβ3-associated FAK, PI3K/AKT, ERK and NF-κB signaling.
limitations: This supports OPN/integrin pathway capacity but not the exact ITGAV/ITGB1 row or an SCI-specific terminal TF.

assay_or_perturbation: TG2/SDC4 association; PKCα and beta1-integrin perturbation; FAK/ERK and matrix-assembly assays
evidence_summary: Extracellular TG2/SDC4 and beta1-integrin co-signaling was associated with PKCα, FAK/ERK, adhesion and matrix assembly.
limitations: The branch is scaffold/co-receptor dependent and does not provide a terminal YAP/TEAD target.

assay_or_perturbation: THY1 RLD ligation; αVβ3/syndecan-4 perturbation; PKCα/RhoA and adhesion assays
evidence_summary: THY1 engagement of αVβ3 with syndecan-4 was associated with PKCα/RhoA-dependent adhesion and mechanotransduction outputs.
limitations: The source does not establish a direct YAP edge or terminal TEAD target and is not necessarily SCI-specific.

assay_or_perturbation: VEGFA165-HBD/αVβ3 binding; VEGFR2 crosstalk; FAK/ERK and migration/proliferation assays
evidence_summary: VEGFA165-associated αVβ3 and VEGFR2 crosstalk was linked to FAK/ERK signaling and endothelial migration or proliferation.
limitations: The 20B composite receptor row is boundary/non-exportable and no terminal TF was measured.
